queries.aggregate:
begin read only;
select jsonb_build_object(
 'employee_rows',(select count(*) from public.employees),
 'duplicate_employee_code_groups',(select count(*) from (select employee_code from public.employees where employee_code is not null group by employee_code having count(*)>1) x),
 'null_employee_codes',(select count(*) from public.employees where employee_code is null),
 'duplicate_employee_identity_groups',(select count(*) from (select business_id,user_id from public.employees where user_id is not null group by business_id,user_id having count(*)>1) x),
 'unlinked_employee_auth_ids',(select count(*) from public.employees where user_id is null),
 'employee_missing_membership',(select count(*) from public.employees e where e.user_id is not null and not exists(select 1 from public.business_members m where m.business_id=e.business_id and m.user_id=e.user_id)),
 'employee_membership_role_mismatch',(select count(*) from public.employees e join public.business_members m on m.business_id=e.business_id and m.user_id=e.user_id where m.role is distinct from case when e.role='manager' then 'manager' when e.role='owner' then 'owner' else 'employee' end),
 'employee_roles',(select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(role,n),'{}') from(select coalesce(role,'<NULL>') role,count(*) n from public.employees group by role) x),
 'products',(select count(*) from public.products),
 'null_selling_prices',(select count(*) from public.products where selling_price is null),
 'zero_selling_prices',(select count(*) from public.products where selling_price=0),
 'negative_selling_prices',(select count(*) from public.products where selling_price<0),
 'nonfinite_selling_prices',(select count(*) from public.products where selling_price::text in ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')),
 'inactive_products',(select count(*) from public.products where is_active is not true or active is false),
 'inventory_product_business_mismatch',(select count(*) from public.inventory i join public.products p on p.id=i.product_id where i.business_id is distinct from p.business_id),
 'movement_product_business_mismatch',(select count(*) from public.inventory_movements i join public.products p on p.id=i.product_id where i.business_id is distinct from p.business_id),
 'sale_membership_business_mismatch',(select count(*) from public.sales s join public.business_members m on m.id=s.employee_id where s.business_id is distinct from m.business_id),
 'sale_item_business_mismatch',(select count(*) from public.sale_items i join public.sales s on s.id=i.sale_id join public.products p on p.id=i.product_id where s.business_id is distinct from p.business_id),
 'sales',(select count(*) from public.sales),
 'sale_requests',(select count(*) from private.sale_requests),
 'duplicate_request_groups',(select count(*) from(select business_id,user_id,request_id from private.sale_requests group by business_id,user_id,request_id having count(*)>1) x),
 'malformed_saved_receipt_ids',(select count(*) from private.sale_requests where receipt->>'id' is null or receipt->>'id' !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'),
 'branch_columns',(select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_schema in ('public','private') and column_name='branch_id'),
 'timezone_column',(select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='businesses' and column_name='timezone'),
 'unvalidated_constraints',(select count(*) from pg_constraint c join pg_class t on t.oid=c.conrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=t.relnamespace where n.nspname in ('public','private') and not c.convalidated)
 ) as integrity_counts; commit;
